item.description:
What's new in ShawNotch 1.8.3

  • Changing the volume, the screen's brightness or the keyboard light shows the level beside the closed notch. You can also scroll on the notch: on its own for the volume, with ⌥ for brightness, with ⌥⇧ for the keyboard light.
  • Copying now shows what you copied beside the notch: a colour's swatch, a link's website, a picture or how many files. A copy can go to the Tray in one click.
  • A download shows its name and speed beside the notch while it comes in, and Done when it's finished.
  • Videos in apps like Slack, Discord or Claude, and in every edition of your browser, no longer count as songs: no record and equalizer beside the notch, and Music Mode leaves your desktop alone. A browser's logo or a video's picture no longer colours the playback line and volume bars.
  • With music playing, ShawNotch uses about a quarter less memory and a little less of your Mac's processor.
